content: The test image shows a tomato field with plants severely wilted and collapsed across entire rows — whole plant symptoms. Let me check the part index, then view reference images for the top wilt candidates.

The test image shows sudden, complete whole-plant collapse while plants are still green — the hallmark of **Bacterial_Wilt** (Ralstonia solanacearum), which causes rapid vascular blockage leading to irreversible whole-plant wilt. The field-wide pattern with plants prostrate on the ground matches this class best.
